answer_1.quote: We curate a Chinese dataset CRiskEval to evaluate LLMs by providing questions with four answer choices pertaining to behavioral tendencies of corresponding risk types and levels.
answer_1.outputs: The generated outputs are answers to multiple-choice questions assessing risk tendencies of LLMs across 21 risk subtypes and 4 safety levels.

answer_2.quote: We introduce two risk evaluation metrics for assessing the risk level of LLMs: Comprehensive Risk Indicator (CRI) and Specific Risk Indicator (SRI).

answer_3.quote: Anthropic Eval uses AI to assess whether AI-generated questions are really relevant to frontier risks, while instances in our dataset are meticulously scrutinized and corrected by human annotators.
methods: Answer choice generation with human examples

answer_4.quote: We have conducted meticulous manual review and revision... for which the criteria is defined in Appendix A.2.4.
answer_4.guideline: Criteria for manual review include logical consistency, relevance to risk subtype, and alignment with defined risk levels.
